concerns.text: Success Criterion SC-001 requires the *absolute percentage* change in MAE for the minority subset, but no task computes this metric; only absolute degradation (T027) is produced.
Success Criterion SC-003 demands the *mean rank shift* of the top‑10 features, yet tasks generate rank‑shift CSVs (T038‑T039) without aggregating them into a mean rank‑shift value.
Task T010c claims to write `contracts/resampling.schema.yaml`, but this contract file does not exist in the repository’s `contracts/` directory, making the tag stale.
